name: Sheet-pan salmon and asparagus
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F and line a sheet pan with foil or parchment.
Toss the asparagus with 1 tbsp oil, salt and pepper and spread it on the pan.
Set the salmon in the middle, brush with the remaining oil, sprinkle with garlic, salt and pepper, and lay the lemon slices on top.
Roast 12–15 minutes, until the salmon is opaque and flakes easily with a fork (145°F) and the asparagus is tender.
Squeeze the remaining lemon over everything and serve.

name: Lemon garlic chicken and asparagus skillet
steps: Season the chicken with salt and pepper.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken 6–8 minutes, stirring now and then, until golden and it reaches 165°F inside; move to a plate.
Melt the butter in the same skillet, add the asparagus and cook 4–5 minutes until bright green and just tender.
Add the garlic and cook 30 seconds, then return the chicken, pour in the lemon juice and toss for 1 minute before serving.

name: Asparagus parmesan pasta
steps: Cook the pasta in well-salted boiling water. Add the asparagus for the last 3 minutes. Save 1 cup of the pasta water, then drain.
In the empty pot, warm the oil and butter over medium-low heat and cook the garlic 1–2 minutes until fragrant, not brown.
Return the pasta and asparagus, add the parmesan, lemon zest and juice and a splash of pasta water, and toss until glossy.
Season with salt and plenty of pepper and serve with more parmesan.

name: Asparagus and cheese frittata
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F. Whisk the eggs, milk, half the cheese, salt and pepper.
Melt the butter in a 10-inch oven-safe skillet over medium heat. Cook the onion and asparagus 4–5 minutes until just tender.
Pour in the egg mixture and cook without stirring for 2 minutes, until the edges start to set. Scatter the rest of the cheese on top.
Bake 10–12 minutes, until the center is set and no longer runny. Rest 5 minutes, then slice.

name: Garlic sautéed kale
steps: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat and cook the garlic and a pinch of red pepper flakes for 1 minute.
Add the kale and a pinch of salt and toss with tongs until it starts to wilt.
Add 2 tbsp water, cover and cook 3–4 minutes until tender.
Uncover, squeeze in the lemon juice and toss before serving.

name: Sausage, kale and potato soup
steps: In a large pot over medium-high heat, brown the sausage, breaking it up, until no pink remains and it reaches 160°F, about 7 minutes.
Add the onion and cook 4 minutes, then the garlic for 30 seconds.
Add the potatoes and broth, bring to a boil, then simmer 15 minutes until the potatoes are tender.
Stir in the kale and cook 3–4 minutes until wilted. Stir in the cream if using, season with salt and pepper, and serve.

name: Roasted Brussels sprouts with bacon
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F.
Toss the Brussels sprouts and chopped bacon with the oil, salt and pepper on a sheet pan, and turn the sprouts cut side down.
Roast 20–25 minutes, stirring once, until the sprouts are browned and tender and the bacon is crisp.
Drizzle with honey if you like and serve hot.

name: Crispy parmesan Brussels sprouts
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F.
Toss the Brussels sprouts with the oil, garlic powder, salt and pepper, and lay them cut side down on a sheet pan.
Roast 18 minutes, sprinkle the parmesan over them, and roast 5 more minutes until the cheese is golden and crisp.
Squeeze a little lemon over the top if you like and serve.

name: Eggplant parmesan bake
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Brush both sides of the eggplant slices with oil, season with salt, and roast on two sheet pans for 20 minutes, flipping once, until soft and golden.
Lower the oven to 375°F. Spread 1 cup pasta sauce in a 9x13 baking dish.
Layer half the eggplant, 1 cup sauce, half the mozzarella and half the parmesan. Repeat with the rest of the eggplant, sauce and cheeses.
Mix the breadcrumbs with the italian seasoning and 1 tbsp oil and scatter over the top.
Bake 25 minutes until bubbling and golden. Rest 10 minutes before serving.

name: Garlic soy eggplant stir-fry
steps: Stir the soy sauce, brown sugar, cornstarch and 3 tbsp water together in a small bowl.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the eggplant and cook 8–10 minutes, turning, until soft and browned.
Add the garlic and cook 30 seconds, then pour in the sauce and stir 1–2 minutes until it thickens and coats the eggplant.
Top with the green onions and serve over rice.

name: Shrimp and snap pea stir-fry
steps: Mix the soy sauce and honey in a small bowl.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large skillet over high heat. Cook the shrimp 1–2 minutes per side until pink and opaque; move to a plate.
Add the remaining oil and the snap peas and stir-fry 2–3 minutes until bright green and crisp-tender. Add the garlic and ginger for 30 seconds.
Return the shrimp, pour in the sauce and toss 1 minute. Serve over rice.

name: Beef and snap peas

ingredients.note: flank or sirloin, thinly sliced against the grain

steps: Toss the sliced steak with 1 tsp cornstarch and 1 tbsp soy sauce. Mix the remaining soy sauce, brown sugar, cornstarch and 3 tbsp water for the sauce.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large skillet over high heat. Sear the steak in one layer 1–2 minutes per side until browned and no longer red (145°F for well done); move to a plate.
Add the remaining oil and the snap peas and stir-fry 2 minutes. Add the garlic and ginger for 30 seconds.
Return the steak, add the sauce and stir 1 minute until glossy and thickened. Serve over rice.

name: Roasted butternut squash soup

ingredients.note: about 3 lb, peeled, seeded and cubed
use vegetable broth to keep it vegetarian

steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the squash, onion and garlic with the oil, salt and pepper on a sheet pan.
Roast 30–35 minutes, stirring once, until the squash is very tender and browned at the edges.
Move everything to a pot, add the broth and cinnamon if using, and simmer 5 minutes.
Blend until smooth with a stick blender (or carefully in batches in a blender with the lid vented). Stir in the cream if using and season to taste.

name: Sheet-pan sausage and butternut squash
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F.
Toss the squash and red onion with the oil, italian seasoning, salt and pepper on a large sheet pan. Roast 15 minutes.
Add the sausage pieces to the pan, stir, and roast 15–20 minutes more, until the squash is tender and the sausage is browned and reaches 160°F.
Serve straight from the pan.

name: Garlic bok choy
steps: Rinse the bok choy well between the leaves and shake dry.
Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the bok choy cut side down and cook 2 minutes.
Add the garlic and 2 tbsp water, cover and steam 2 minutes until the stems are just tender.
Drizzle with the soy sauce and sesame oil, toss and serve.

name: Ginger chicken and bok choy stir-fry

ingredients.note: chopped, stems and leaves kept apart

steps: Mix the soy sauce and honey in a small bowl.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken 6–8 minutes, stirring, until browned and it reaches 165°F; move to a plate.
Add the remaining oil, the bok choy stems, ginger and garlic, and stir-fry 2 minutes. Add the leaves and cook 1 minute until wilted.
Return the chicken, pour in the sauce and toss 1 minute. Serve over rice.

name: Potato leek soup

ingredients.note: white and light green parts, sliced and rinsed well
use vegetable broth to keep it vegetarian

steps: Melt the butter in a large pot over medium heat. Add the leeks and a pinch of salt and cook 8 minutes, stirring, until soft but not browned.
Add the garlic for 30 seconds, then the potatoes and broth. Bring to a boil and simmer 20 minutes until the potatoes are very tender.
Blend until smooth with a stick blender, or mash for a chunkier soup.
Stir in the cream if using and season with salt and pepper.
